title: The Messengership Of Prophet Muhammad 16th Degree Summary Judgment And The Text There Is No God But Allah

questions.question: What central belief is being declared at the beginning of the target passage?
questions.answer: It declares belief that only Allah deserves worship and that He necessarily exists, is One, and has no partner.

questions.question: According to the passage, which person is presented as a major witness to Allah’s existence and oneness?
questions.answer: The Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, is presented as that witness.

questions.question: What titles are given to the Prophet in the passage to show his high rank among humanity?
questions.answer: He is described as the pride of the world and the honor of the children of Adam.

questions.question: Which four qualities of the Prophet are mentioned as signs supporting his truthfulness?
questions.answer: The greatness of the Qur’an given to him, the wide reach of his religion, his many excellences, and his noble character.

questions.question: Why is the mention of his enemies important in this passage?
questions.answer: It shows that even those against him could not deny his outstanding qualities, which strengthens the proof.

questions.question: Besides personal qualities, what two broad kinds of evidence are said to support his testimony?
questions.answer: His clear miracles and the many strong truths found in his religion.

questions.question: How are the miracles described in a way that increases confidence in them?
questions.answer: They are presented as obvious and shining signs that both prove the truth and are themselves confirmed as true.

questions.question: What does the passage suggest about the teachings of his religion?
questions.answer: It suggests that they are many, full of light, and decisive in leading to certainty.

questions.question: Which three groups are said to agree in confirming this testimony?
questions.answer: The family or people of light around him, his enlightened Companions, and the scholars of his community who have proof and insight.

questions.question: What does the agreement of these three groups add to the argument?
questions.answer: It shows that the testimony is not just one person’s claim but is strongly supported by a wide and trustworthy community.

questions.question: How does the passage connect unity of Allah with the Prophet’s mission?
questions.answer: It presents the Prophet as clearly pointing people to Allah’s oneness through his message, life, miracles, and character.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the whole target passage?
questions.answer: The passage argues that belief in Allah’s oneness is strongly supported by the Prophet’s truthfulness, his miracles, his religion, and the united confirmation of righteous people and scholars.

questions.question: In simple terms, what statement of faith is restated in the target passage?
questions.answer: It restates that there is no true god but Allah, Who truly exists by necessity and is absolutely one.

questions.question: How does the passage describe Allah in relation to existence and unity?
questions.answer: It says His existence is necessary and His oneness is absolute.

questions.question: Who is described as showing this truth to people?
questions.answer: The Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, is described as showing it.

questions.question: What part does the Qur’an play in proving his truthfulness according to the passage?
questions.answer: The greatness and authority of the Qur’an given to him are presented as one of the major signs that support him.

questions.question: What does the spread of his religion suggest in the passage?
questions.answer: It suggests that his message has strong truth and powerful influence.

questions.question: How does the passage use the Prophet’s moral character as evidence?
questions.answer: It treats his lofty character as a proof that he was truthful and guided by Allah.

questions.question: What can be inferred from the fact that even opponents confirmed some of his qualities?
questions.answer: It can be inferred that his excellence was so clear that it was hard to deny even for those who resisted him.

questions.question: What role do miracles have in the argument of the passage?
questions.answer: They serve as strong, visible signs that support the truth of his message.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention not just one or two truths in the religion, but thousands?
questions.answer: It emphasizes that the religion contains a large body of clear and convincing teachings, not a weak or limited message.

questions.question: What kind of scholars are mentioned near the end of the passage?
questions.answer: They are scholars known for solid proof, careful verification, and enlightened understanding.

questions.question: How is collective agreement used as a form of evidence here?
questions.answer: The shared agreement of noble family members, Companions, and scholars is used to show broad and reliable confirmation.

questions.question: If you had to summarize the argument in one sentence, what would it be?
questions.answer: The passage teaches that Allah’s oneness is powerfully confirmed through the Prophet’s message, miracles, character, and the united testimony of trusted believers and scholars.

questions.question: What does the passage say about Allah before discussing the Prophet’s evidence?
questions.answer: It says that Allah alone is worthy of worship, necessarily exists, and is one without equal.

questions.question: Why is the Prophet linked so closely to proving this belief?
questions.answer: Because he is presented as the one who clearly testifies to and gives evidence for Allah’s existence and unity.

questions.question: What does the phrase about the Prophet’s high status among humanity show?
questions.answer: It shows that he holds a uniquely honored place because of his mission and excellence.

questions.question: Name one sign connected to revelation and one sign connected to personal character that support the Prophet in this passage.
questions.answer: One sign connected to revelation is the greatness of the Qur’an, and one sign connected to personal character is his elevated morals.

questions.question: What is the effect of mentioning the wide extent of his religion?
questions.answer: It highlights that his message was not small or hidden but broad, influential, and lasting.

questions.question: How does the passage present miracles: as hidden claims or as clear signs?
questions.answer: It presents them as clear and evident signs.

questions.question: What does it mean that the miracles are also confirmed by true testimony?
questions.answer: It means people did not just hear of them vaguely; they were also affirmed by trustworthy witness and recognition.

questions.question: How are the teachings of the religion described in terms of clarity and certainty?
questions.answer: They are described as bright and decisive, giving strong conviction.

questions.question: Which group represents close companionship with the Prophet in the passage?
questions.answer: His Companions represent that close companionship.

questions.question: Which group represents later intellectual and scholarly confirmation?
questions.answer: The scholars of his community represent that later scholarly confirmation.

questions.question: Why is it important that different kinds of people agree with the Prophet’s testimony?
questions.answer: It is important because support from different groups makes the evidence stronger and more balanced.

questions.question: What overall conclusion about faith should a student draw from this passage?
questions.answer: A student should conclude that belief in Allah’s oneness rests on strong proof through revelation, prophetic character, miracles, and the agreement of trustworthy believers.

questions.question: What is the first truth affirmed in the target passage?
questions.answer: The first truth is that only Allah is God and that He necessarily exists in perfect oneness.

questions.question: Whose witness is highlighted right after that declaration?
questions.answer: The witness of the Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, is highlighted.

questions.question: According to the passage, what makes the Prophet an especially weighty witness?
questions.answer: The majesty of the Qur’an, the broad reach of his religion, his many perfections, and his noble manners make his witness especially weighty.

questions.question: How does the passage strengthen its case by referring to enemies?
questions.answer: It shows that his greatness was recognized even by opponents, which makes the evidence harder to dismiss.

questions.question: What two categories of proof are attached to the Prophet’s witness?
questions.answer: The two categories are his many obvious miracles and the numerous firm truths in his religion.

questions.question: What does the wording about “hundreds” and “thousands” suggest?
questions.answer: It suggests abundance and repeated confirmation rather than a single isolated proof.

questions.question: How are the truths in his religion portrayed: doubtful or decisive?
questions.answer: They are portrayed as decisive and full of light.

questions.question: Who are the “possessors of light” in the passage’s line of support?
questions.answer: They are presented as a spiritually illuminated group connected with him and affirming his message.

questions.question: What special quality is linked with the Companions in this passage?
questions.answer: They are described as enlightened and in agreement with his testimony.

questions.question: What special qualities are linked with the scholars of the community?
questions.answer: They are linked with strong proof and clear inner understanding.

questions.question: What is the author’s purpose in this target passage?
questions.answer: The purpose is to strengthen faith in Allah’s oneness by presenting the Prophet’s life, message, and supporters as compelling evidence.

questions.question: What belief about Allah is stated in a complete and direct way in the target passage?
questions.answer: Allah alone is God, His existence is necessary, and He is one and unique.

questions.question: Through whom is this belief said to be strongly indicated?
questions.answer: It is said to be strongly indicated through the Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: How does the passage connect the Qur’an to the Prophet’s credibility?
questions.answer: It presents the greatness and authority of the Qur’an as one of the major signs that support his truthfulness.

questions.question: What does the broad spread of the religion point to in the passage?
questions.answer: It points to the strength and seriousness of his mission.

questions.question: Why are the Prophet’s many excellences mentioned along with his character?
questions.answer: They show both outward achievement and inward moral beauty, giving a fuller picture of his truthfulness.

questions.question: What inference can be made from the statement that enemies also testified to his qualities?
questions.answer: The inference is that his virtues were public and undeniable, not just praised by followers.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the miracles in relation to proof?
questions.answer: It describes them as strong, open signs that verify the message.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the teachings of the religion in relation to reason and certainty?
questions.answer: It describes them as clear and conclusive truths that support firm belief.

questions.question: What is the value of consensus in this passage?
questions.answer: Consensus adds reliability by showing that many trustworthy people reached the same conclusion.

questions.question: Which three communities form that consensus?
questions.answer: The Prophet’s luminous family or close people, his Companions, and the verifying scholars of his ummah.

questions.question: How does this passage balance spiritual and intellectual evidence?
questions.answer: It includes spiritual light, moral excellence, miracles, and scholarly proof together.

questions.question: What is the strongest summary of the passage for an 11th-grade student?
questions.answer: The passage teaches that Islam’s core belief in Allah’s oneness is supported by the Prophet’s life, message, miracles, and the united witness of righteous and knowledgeable Muslims.

questions.question: What declaration of tawhid appears at the center of this target passage?
questions.answer: The declaration is that there is no god but Allah, Who necessarily exists and is one.

questions.question: What does the passage say the Prophet does regarding this truth?
questions.answer: It says he testifies to it and provides evidence for it.

questions.question: Which feature of the Prophet’s message is linked to majesty and authority?
questions.answer: The Qur’an associated with him is linked to majesty and authority.

questions.question: Which feature shows the reach and influence of his way of life?
questions.answer: The wide extent of his religion shows that reach and influence.

questions.question: Which personal features of the Prophet are used as proof in the passage?
questions.answer: His many excellences and his elevated character are used as proof.

questions.question: Why is outside acknowledgment significant when judging a person’s truthfulness?
questions.answer: Because recognition from opponents can show that the person’s strengths are real and not exaggerated by supporters.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the number and quality of the Prophet’s miracles?
questions.answer: It says they are numerous and clearly visible, giving strong support to his truthfulness.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the truths within his religion?
questions.answer: It says they are many, shining, and decisive.

questions.question: What three layers of supporters confirm the Prophet’s testimony?
questions.answer: Spiritually illuminated supporters, his enlightened Companions, and scholars with proof and insight confirm it.

questions.question: How do those three layers work together in the argument?
questions.answer: They combine spiritual witness, lived experience, and scholarly examination.

questions.question: What final conclusion does the passage guide the reader toward?
questions.answer: It guides the reader toward firm belief in Allah’s existence and oneness through the trustworthy witness of the Prophet and the agreement of the believing community.
